hook_en: He knows exactly how you're made. 🙏
reflect_en: As a father has compassion on his children, the LORD looks at you with tender care. He knows your frame and is mindful that you are dust, so you can start this Monday honest about your limits and held by His compassion.
q_en: Where do you need God's compassion as this week begins?
x_en: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
tiktok: Start your week held by a Father's compassion 🙏 Psalm 103:13–14 — He knows our frame
yt_title: As a Father Has Compassion | Psalm 103:13–14 #Shorts
li_open: Good leaders know the limits of the people they lead.
li_quote: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
li_body: God's compassion is not naive; it comes from fully knowing our frame and remembering that we are dust. Leaders who notice when their people are stretched thin, and pray for them instead of only pushing harder, reflect that same fatherly care.
reflect_es: Como el padre se compadece de los hijos, así te mira Dios con ternura. Él conoce tu condición y se acuerda de que somos polvo, así que puedes comenzar este lunes siendo sincero con tus límites y descansando en Su compasión.
q_es: ¿En qué área necesitas la compasión de Dios al comenzar esta semana?
x_es: Como el padre se compadece de los hijos, se compadece Jehová de los que le temen.
